args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploy of v2.3.1. Per runbook, rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback health checks pass in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure pending investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Reviewed deployment history**: v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy *production* release was **v2.3.0** (the v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it wasn't eligible).
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified health**: service is now healthy in all regions with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback; on-call has been paged for follow-up/root-cause investigation.
